fields.name: Uji/Porridge
fields.description: Enjoy a warm, nourishing bowl of uji(Fermented and Unfermented).  Known for its smooth texture and rich, comforting taste , perfect for starting your day with energy and warmth.
fields.ingredients:
Millet, Sorghum,  Maize flour,
Water,
Sugar (optional),
Milk (optional)
best_with_foods: Milk or tea on the side
fields.recipe_steps:
Mix flour with a little cold water to form a smooth paste.
Boil water in a pot.
Add the paste while stirring continuously.
Cook on low heat, stirring until it thickens.
Add sugar or milk (optional).
Serve hot.

fields.name: Sweet Potatoes
fields.description: Just Perfect For You! Enjoy  a bowl of naturally sweet Sweet potatoes, nutrient-rich roots rich in fiber, vitamin A, and energy. They can be boiled, roasted, fried, or mashed into simple, filling meals or snacks.
fields.ingredients: Sweet potatoes, Water (For Boiling), Cooking Oil(For Frying)
fields.recipe_steps:
Boiling: Peel and wash sweet potatoes, cut if needed, add to boiling salted water, cook until soft, then drain and serve.

Frying: Peel and slice sweet potatoes, heat oil in a pan, fry until golden and crisp, then drain and serve hot.

fields.name: Boiled Maize (Mahindi)
fields.description: Enjoy tender, naturally sweet maize kernels boiled in lightly salted water, a simple and filling Kenyan snack or meal.
fields.ingredients: Fresh Maize, Water,  Salt (Optional)
fields.recipe_steps: Boil peeled maize in water until soft, add salt if desired, drain and serve hot.

fields.name: Sausage + Bread
fields.description: Enjoy a simple, tasty combo of juicy grilled or fried sausage served in soft or toasted bread. Perfect for a quick, filling snack or breakfast.
fields.ingredients: "Sausages", "Bread", Oil/Blueband/Margarine(For Toasting Bread)
fields.recipe_steps: Fry or grill sausages until cooked through, place inside or alongside bread, add sauces or toppings, and serve hot.

fields.name: Arrowroots (Nduma)
fields.description: Earthy, wholesome tubers with a soft, slightly nutty taste when boiled, making a warm and satisfying traditional meal.
fields.ingredients: "Arrowroots", "Water", "Salt (Optional)"
fields.recipe_steps:
Wash and peel arrowroots.
Boil in water until tender.
Add salt if desired.
Drain and serve hot.

fields.name: Mahindi Choma (Roasted Maize)
fields.description: Smoky, charred maize roasted over an open flame, delivering a bold, crunchy and slightly sweet street-style flavor.
fields.ingredients: Fresh maize, Salt(Optional), Chili Powder
fields.recipe_steps:
Roast maize over hot coals or flame,
Turn until evenly charred.
Apply add-ons if desired.
Serve hot.

fields.name: Ugali
fields.description: A firm, smooth maize flour staple cooked with boiling water. The heart of any Kenyan meal. Filling, cheap, and pairs with almost everything.
fields.ingredients: Maize flour, Water, Salt
fields.recipe_steps:
Boil 2 cups of water in a sufuria and add a pinch of salt
Slowly add maize flour while stirring continuously
Keep stirring on medium heat to avoid lumps
Reduce heat, cover and let it cook for 5 minutes
Stir again firmly until ugali is thick and leaves the sides
Shape and serve hot

fields.name: Chapati Rolex
fields.description: Popular East African street food made with chapati rolled with eggs and fresh vegetables.
fields.ingredients: Chapati, Eggs, Tomato, Onion, Cabbage, Cooking oil, Salt, Black pepper
fields.recipe_steps:
Prepare chapati.
Beat eggs with onions and tomatoes.
Fry egg mixture.
Place eggs on chapati and roll.
Serve hot.

fields.name: Steamed White Rice
fields.description:
Soft, fluffy steamed white rice cooked to perfection. 
A versatile staple meal that pairs well with different stew options 
such as beef stew, chicken stew, fish stew, lentil stew, and vegetable curry.
fields.ingredients: Rice, Water, Salt, Cooking Oil or Butter
fields.recipe_steps:
Wash the rice thoroughly with clean water.
Boil water in a cooking pot.
Add rice and a little salt.
Cook on medium heat until the water is absorbed.
Reduce heat and cover the pot.",
Allow the rice to steam until soft and fluffy.
Serve hot with your preferred stew option.

fields.name: Sukuma Wiki
fields.description: Braised kale cooked with onions and tomatoes. A classic budget-friendly side that goes perfectly with ugali.
fields.ingredients: Kale (Sukuma Wiki), Onion, Tomato, Cooking Oil, Salt
fields.recipe_steps:
Wash and chop the sukuma wiki (kale)
Slice onions and tomatoes
Heat cooking oil in a pan
Fry onions until golden brown
Add tomatoes, then cook until soft
Add chopped sukuma wiki and stir well
Season with salt
Cook for 5–7 minutes until tender
Serve hot with Ugali

fields.name: Beef Stew
fields.description: Rich and flavorful Kenyan-style beef stew cooked with tomatoes, onions, and spices.
fields.ingredients: Beef, Onion, Tomato, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking oil, Salt, Black pepper, Coriander
fields.recipe_steps:
Heat oil and fry onions until golden.
Add garlic and ginger.
Add tomatoes and cook into a thick sauce.
Add beef pieces and stir well.
Add water and simmer until meat is tender.
Season and serve hot.

fields.name: Chicken Stew
fields.description: Tender chicken pieces simmered in a rich tomato and herb sauce.
fields.ingredients: Chicken, Tomatoes, Onions, Garlic, Ginger, Cooking Oil, Coriander
fields.recipe_steps:
Boil or fry chicken pieces.
Prepare tomato sauce with onions and spices.
Add chicken and simmer.
Cook until tender.
Serve hot with rice.

fields.name: Bean Stew
fields.description: Rich and hearty bean stew cooked with tomatoes, onions, and spices. A nutritious and affordable option for rice.
fields.ingredients: Beans, Tomatoes, Onions, Garlic, Cooking Oil, Salt, Coriander
fields.recipe_steps:
Boil beans until soft.
Fry onions, tomatoes, and garlic.
Add beans and spices.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve hot with rice.

fields.name: Fish Coconut Stew
fields.description: Delicious fish fillet simmered in creamy coconut sauce with herbs and spices.
fields.ingredients: Fish Fillet, Coconut Milk, Tomatoes, Garlic, Lemon Juice, Coriander
fields.recipe_steps:
Season fish and lightly fry.
Prepare coconut sauce.
Add fish into the sauce.
Simmer gently for 10 minutes.
Serve hot with rice.

fields.name: Lentil Curry
fields.description: Creamy lentil curry with mild spices and coconut flavor, perfect with steamed rice.
fields.ingredients: Lentils, Coconut Milk, Tomatoes, Onions, Curry Powder, Garlic
fields.recipe_steps:
Boil lentils until tender.",
Prepare curry base using onions and tomatoes.
Add coconut milk and lentils.
Cook until thick.
Serve with rice.

fields.name: Beef Stew
fields.description: Slow-cooked beef stew with rich gravy and aromatic spices.
fields.ingredients: Beef, Tomatoes, Onions, Garlic, Ginger, Carrots, Cooking Oil, Potatoes(Optional)
fields.recipe_steps:
Boil beef until tender.
Fry onions, garlic, and tomatoes.
Add beef and spices.
Simmer to form thick gravy.
Serve with rice.

fields.name: Lamb Stew
fields.description: Premium slow-cooked lamb stew with herbs, vegetables, and rich flavorful gravy.
fields.ingredients: Lamb Meat, Carrots, Potatoes, Garlic, Rosemary, Tomatoes, Onions
fields.recipe_steps:
Brown lamb pieces in a pot.
Add vegetables and spices.
Pour water or stock and simmer slowly.
Cook until lamb is soft and tender.
Serve warm with rice.

fields.name: Noodles
fields.description: A quick, versatile dish of soft strands, often cooked and served with sauces, vegetables, or meat.
fields.can_combine_with: Vegetables, Eggs, Chicken, Beef, Sausages, Beans, Soy sauce , Spices, e.g Garlic
fields.cooking_tip: Boil 2 cups water, Add noodles for 3 mins, Add seasoning
fields.upgrade_tip: Add 1 egg (Ksh 15) + dhania (Ksh 5) for a fuller meal + 1 Tomato(Ksh 10) + Hoho(Ksh 10) + Carrot(Ksh 10)

fields.name: Maize Flour
fields.description: Staple grain flour used to make ugali — the backbone of Kenyan meals
fields.can_combine_with: Sukuma Wiki, Beans, Eggs, Cabbage, Ndengu, Meat, Fish
fields.cooking_tip: Boil 2 cups water, add flour gradually while stirring to avoid lumps, cook on low heat for 10 mins
fields.upgrade_tip: Add more water for softer ugali, or less for firmer ugali that holds its shape better

fields.name: Eggs(Mayai)
fields.description: Versatile, Nutrient-dense protein sources consisting of a protective shell, a clear white, and a vitamin-rich yolk.
fields.cooking_tip: Fry onion first, add tomato, then beat and pour eggs — scrambles in 3 mins
fields.upgrade_tip: Add dhania and hoho for a fuller scrambled egg.

fields.name: Rice
fields.description: Loved by half the Population. Rich in Starch.
fields.can_combine_with: Beans, Ndengu, Cabbage, Sukuma Wiki, Meat, Any Cereal
fields.cooking_tip: Rinse rice, boil 2:1 water ratio, simmer covered for 15 mins
fields.upgrade_tip: Add onion and tomato when boiling for pilau-style rice

fields.name: Noodles
fields.description: A quick, versatile dish of soft strands, often cooked and served with sauces, vegetables, or meat.
fields.steps:
Boil 1.5 cups of water.
Add noodles for 3 mins.
Add seasoning. OR:

Sauté 1/2 onion in oil until soft.
Add noodles and 1.5 cups of water (or broth).
Cook for 3-4 mins until water evaporates.
Then add seasoning."
fields.upgrade_with:
Add 1 egg (Ksh 15) + dhania (Ksh 5)+ 1 Tomato(Ksh 10) + Hoho(Ksh 10) + Carrot(Ksh 10)
FOR A FULLER MEAL

fields.name: Ugali & Sukuma Wiki
fields.description: The backbone of every comrade's diet. It is cheap, filling, and takes less than 20 minutes to prepare.
fields.kitchen_items_needed: Cooking oil, Salt, Water, Maize flour, Sukuma Wiki
fields.steps:
Boil water in a sufuria.
Add maize flour gradually while stirring until thick and firm.
In a separate pan, fry onions and tomatoes until soft, you can add spices too after frying onions and tomatoes.
Add chopped sukuma wiki and salt; stir for 5 minutes.
Serve hot.
fields.upgrade_with: Add a fried Egg, Meat or Avocado if the HELB has landed.

fields.name: Fried Githeri
fields.description: A protein-packed mix of maize and beans that keeps you full for hours during long lectures.
fields.steps:
Fry onions in a pot until golden brown.
Add tomatoes, cook until soft then diced potatoes
Pour in the boiled githeri and add half a cup of water.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Season and serve.
fields.upgrade_with: Add carrots, hoho or dhania (coriander) for extra flavor.

fields.name: Cabbage & Rice (The End-Month Special)
fields.description: A very light and affordable meal when the budget is tight. Great for a quick dinner.
fields.steps:
Boil rice with salt until water is absorbed.
Shred cabbage into thin strips.
Fry onions in oil, then add the cabbage.
Stir-fry for 5-8 minutes (keep it crunchy).
Mix with rice or serve on the side.
fields.upgrade_with: Add soy sauce or a cube of beef stock for a 'fried rice' vibe.

fields.name: Ugali & Mayai (Eggs)
fields.description: The ultimate 'end of the month' protein boost. Fast, reliable, and keeps you going through long study nights.
fields.steps:
Prepare the ugali by adding flour to boiling water and stirring until firm.
Beat the eggs in a cup with a pinch of salt.
Heat oil in a pan and fry chopped onions until soft.
Pour in the eggs and scramble or fry as a flat omelette.
Serve the hot eggs alongside the ugali.
fields.upgrade_with: Add a side of sliced avocado or a simple kachumbari.
